## Recommendation
Focus the next quarter of product effort on issue-usability. While issue-playback has a higher mean severity [CL-011], issue-usability has the highest priority score [CL-004] and the highest number of complaints [CL-001].

## Supporting numbers
issue-usability has a priority score of 37 [CL-004], a complaint count of 15 [CL-001], and a severity sum of 37 [CL-002].

## Alternatives
issue-other is the next priority with a priority score of 29 [CL-008]. issue-playback is also a significant concern due to its high mean severity of 3.666667 [CL-011], but its priority score is lower at 22 [CL-012].
